title: TargetManifest
description: A data-only descriptor of a factory target. Repo coordinates + adapter selections (names, never code) + role/capability bindings + compliance-rule path + operational build ABI + effort params + demo-env descriptor. The core imports nothing this file names.

schema_version.description: Schema/2 (plan 2.1): ONE digest over the raw bytes that were read; the in-file content_digest self-claim is gone (a file cannot vouch for itself). A /1 manifest refuses at parse — fail-closed re-declaration, no legacy-acceptance path.

target_id.description: Stable, opaque target id — namespaces every run, index, token, and ledger entry (no-cross-repo-bleed).

subpath.description: Optional monorepo subpath the target lives under.

rules_path.description: Path (within the target checkout) to the fed-in compliance ruleset — declarative data the ComplianceAdapter surfaces. Never code.

pattern_catalog_digest.description: Externally authorized address of the pre-qualified construction catalog.

max_attempts.description: Hard ceiling for BUILDING entries in one run; a lower per-run plan limit is allowed.

construction_modes.description: Target-authorized construction modes. Regeneration keeps a complete rewrite ordinary.

signal.description: Signal-deadline knobs (remediation plan 0.4): pass-denominated deadline and warn (founder defaults 4/3; deadline must not exceed build.max_attempts) plus the mandatory wall-clock cap on elapsed-since-last-pass-advance. Optional at parse until the factory-target-manifest/2 bump; generation readiness refuses a run whose target omits them (signal-knobs-undeclared) — configurable never means disable-able.

signal_pass_deadline.description: By end of this pass a NO-relevant signal or terminal must exist, or residual blockers must be absent.

signal_pass_warn.description: WARN host event at this pass; must not exceed signal_pass_deadline.

signal_wall_clock_cap_hours.description: Backstop on elapsed hours since last pass advance — the only control catching the zero-pass hung-lane class. Value ratified at the Phase 0 sitting. Finite by construction: bounded above by one year (8760h); inf refuses at parse (round-4 D4).

key_id.description: The only in-file signature field: which detached trust-root key seals this manifest. The signature VALUE stays with the trust root, outside the file it signs; verification (dormant seam) runs over the raw bytes.
